seo.title: iCloud Sync and connection sharing for teams
seo.description: Keep connections, groups and tags in step across your Mac, iPhone and iPad with iCloud Sync, share connection files, and publish to your team’s library.

header.title: Sync and sharing
header.lead: Sync connections through iCloud, share connection files or publish connections and queries to your team.

sections.title: iCloud Sync
paragraphs: Sync through a private iCloud database across your Macs, iPhone and iPad. Enable it separately on each device. iCloud Sync requires Starter or Team on Mac and is free on iPhone and iPad.

Passwords sync separately through iCloud Keychain when you enable <ui>Passwords</ui> on Mac or <ui>Sync Passwords</ui> on mobile. The Mac switch also syncs stored AI and license keys. Mark connections Local only to exclude them and their saved queries from sync.
points: On the Mac you choose what syncs: connections, groups and tags, settings, SSH profiles, credential profiles (their name and username, never the password), table and database favorites, saved queries with their SQL, and table folders.
On iPhone and iPad: connections, groups and tags.
A synced connection carries its host, port, username, database, SSH and TLS settings, startup commands, pre-connect script and AI rules.
Never synced: query history, Data Rewind, password sources, tunnel commands and each connection’s External Clients level.

sections.title: Handoff
paragraphs: Continue with the same saved connection or table on another Apple device. Both devices need the connection synced through iCloud; a file-imported copy has a different ID. Handoff passes the connection ID and table name through Apple, not the query session. With no table open, it passes the connection’s name instead, or its host if unnamed.

sections.title: Share a connection
paragraphs: Export a .tablepro file with connection settings, groups and tags, without passwords. Encrypted Export includes passwords under a passphrase using AES-256-GCM. Importing either format is free on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Encrypted password export is free on iPhone and iPad. Share links using tablepro://import carry connection settings, never passwords.

sections.title: Linked Folders
paragraphs: Watch a folder of .tablepro connection files, such as a Git checkout or shared drive. Edit connections through their files, not the app. Encrypted files are skipped; startup and tunnel commands are ignored.
Linked Folders is for connection files. Linked SQL folders are a separate, free feature for saved .sql queries.

links.label: Saved queries and linked SQL folders

sections.title: Team Catalog and Team Library
paragraphs: Share through your own folder with Team Catalog, or through TablePro's server with Team Library.

blocks.title: Team Catalog
paragraphs: <ui>Share > Publish to Team Catalog…</ui> writes password-free connection files to your shared folder. Teammates add it as a Linked Folder. Your drive or repository carries the files, not TablePro's server.

blocks.title: Team Library
paragraphs: <ui>Share > Publish to Team Library…</ui> and <ui>Publish Saved Queries to Team…</ui> upload connection settings and saved-query SQL to TablePro's server, never passwords. Macs on the license download them. Startup and tunnel commands are ignored. Republishing replaces your previous contribution.

links.label: What Team Library sends to TablePro

sections.title: Team seats
paragraphs: A Team seat is one activated Mac, not one person. The purchaser manages invitations and seats through their web account. Invitees receive a single-use code for <ui>Settings > License</ui>; each invitation needs an available seat.

Change subscription seats in your account; contact support for one-time purchases. Removing a teammate frees their seat and deletes their Team Library contributions. Paid access ends at the next license check, within {licenseCheckDays} days.

sections.title: On iPhone and iPad
paragraphs: The iPhone and iPad app syncs connections, groups and tags through iCloud, takes part in Handoff, and imports and exports .tablepro files, with passwords under a passphrase if you choose. Linked Folders, Team Catalog and Team Library are in the Mac app only.

links.label: TablePro for iPhone and iPad with your Mac

availability.label: Choose what syncs and keep connections Local only

limits: When a plan ends on the Mac, iCloud Sync pauses and says why, and connections from Linked Folders and the Team Library disappear from the list. The Team publishing commands are hidden, and Encrypted Export loses its password option.

Editing a synced connection on iPhone or iPad can change settings the app there does not have. A stricter Mac Safe Mode level, such as Safe Mode (Full), comes back as Alert, and SSH jump hosts may not survive the trip. Make changes to those connections on the Mac.
If a Team license ends or is suspended, what was published to the Team Library stays on TablePro’s server until you ask for it to be deleted.
